title: AI incident disclosure rate record
description: One published AI incident, with a three-state provenance for every numeric field. recoverable = published (cite source); derivable = computable from published figures (the tool emits the arithmetic); not_recoverable = genuinely absent from public sources. Never estimate.

published_headline.description: The rate/count as the source headlines it, in its own (incompatible) unit. Feeds Table A's naive column.

estimand.description: What the disclosure actually measures (e.g. containment_breach_incident, cheating_propensity). Two disclosures are poolable only if they share an estimand.

poolability.description: Whether a comparable per-run rate on the shared estimand can be obtained, and if not, the first reason it fails. This is the un-attackable classification: it holds even if a value is recoverable from secondary sources.

pending.description: true = stub awaiting hand-verified data; no numeric field may carry an invented value.

provenance.description: recoverable: citation (what the source says). derivable: leave to the tool (it writes the arithmetic). not_recoverable: why it is absent.

location.description: page / section / figure of the primary source

allOf.comment: not_recoverable and derivable inputs carry no value; only recoverable may state a number.
